lines.en: Whoa! Are you the transfer student?
lines.speaker: Xiaolan

lines.ja: 分からないことがあったら、なんでも聞いてね！
lines.en: If there's anything you don't know, just ask me!
lines.speaker: Xiaolan

lines.ja: あっ、ねえねえ、もう見た？
lines.en: Oh, hey, hey, have you seen him yet?
lines.speaker: Xiaolan

lines.ja: この学園の生徒会長ってね、
lines.speaker: Xiaolan

lines.ja: すっごくかっこいいんだよ！
lines.speaker: Xiaolan

lines.ja: 猫猫って変わってるよねー。
lines.en: Maomao, you're pretty eccentric, aren't you?
lines.speaker: Zicui

lines.ja: あ、今度小蘭と３人で遊びに行こうよ！
lines.en: Hey, let's hang out with Xiaolan, the three of us sometime!
lines.speaker: Zicui

lines.ja: 植物園なんかどうかな？
lines.en: How about somewhere like the botanical garden?
lines.speaker: Zicui

lines.en: I heard there are bugs too!
lines.speaker: Zicui

lines.ja: 虫を見ながらみんなで美味しいスイーツ食べようよ！
lines.en: Let's all eat delicious sweets while watching bugs!
lines.speaker: Zicui

clips.title: You'll Work for the Student Council

lines.ja: ほう、君が噂の転校生か。
lines.en: Oho, so you're the rumored transfer student.
lines.speaker: Jinshi

lines.ja: 色々と事件を解決しているらしいじゃないか。
lines.en: Apparently, you've been solving all kinds of incidents, haven't you?
lines.speaker: Jinshi

lines.ja: 生徒会に入って、この学園のために働いてもらうぞ。
lines.en: You'll join the student council and work for this school.
lines.speaker: Jinshi
